name: Git
description: WebStorm-style Git log for Orca: branches, commits and the files of a multi-commit selection with a side-by-side diff. Fork of emamalet/Orca-git-log-panel.

screenshots.caption: Double-click a changed file to see its diff, side by side or unified

screenshots.alt: Interactive rebase dialog listing four commits with pick actions
screenshots.caption: Interactive rebase: reorder, squash, fixup, reword or drop
